channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: MR wants to get back gold in 2027
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia Rugby (MR) aims to reclaim the rugby 7s gold medal at the 2027 Kuala Lumpur SEA Games.

item.title: Malaysia target full 11-title assault at Asiad eSports
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia Esports Federation (MESF) will field teams in all 11 eSports titles at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games from Sept 11 to Oct 4, underlining the country’s most ambitious continental push yet.

item.title: Eight women injured after Batu Ferringhi homestay catches fire
item.description: GEORGE TOWN: Eight women narrowly escaped a predawn fire at a three-story homestay in Solok Sungai Emas, Batu Ferringhi, earlier today.

item.title: Make police personnel well-being a national priority
item.description: Make police personnel well-being a national priority

item.title: Four remanded after violent mall attack in Penang
item.description: GEORGE TOWN: Police believe the arrest of four people, including two businessmen and a company administrator, will resolve the investigation into a violent slashing at a shopping mall along Jalan Kelawai last Wednesday.

item.title: Shooter Johnathan gunning for his third Olympics
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Veteran Johnathan Wong remains the main hope of the National Shooting Association of Malaysia (NSAM), and he is set to make his third Olympic appearance at the 2028 Los Angeles Games.

item.title: Child abuse networks striking while authorities move slowly, activist warns
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Organised online child sexual abuse networks are not waiting for Putrajaya to review existing laws before striking again, warned child rights activist Datuk Hartini Zainudin.

item.title: Bursa Malaysia likely to trade sideways at 1,710-1,740 next week
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Bursa Malaysia is expected to trade sideways within the 1,710–1,740 range next week, said Rakuten Trade Sdn Bhd vice-president of equity research Thong Pak Leng.

item.title: No more Mr. Nice Kim as Selangor boss demands final-day fire
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Selangor coach Kim Pan Gon urged his team to treat every remaining Super League match like a final following a disappointing 0-0 draw against Melaka at the Hang Jebat Stadium on Saturday.

item.title: Western Japan cities hike tourism-linked fees to deal with overtourism
item.description: KYOTO: The city government of Kyoto raised its lodging tax for people staying at hotels and other accommodations from Sunday, collecting up to 10,000 yen (US$64.1) per person per night, Kyodo News Agency reported.
